output_summary.sql: SELECT pc."name" AS category_name, SUM(sod."orderqty") AS total_qty FROM "sales"."salesorderdetail" sod JOIN "sales"."salesorderheader" soh ON sod."salesorderid" = soh."salesorderid" JOIN "production"."product" p ON sod."productid" = p."productid" JOIN "production"."productsubcategory" ps ON p."productsubcategoryid" = ps."productsubcategoryid" JOIN "production"."productcategory" pc ON ps."productcategoryid" = pc."productcategoryid" WHERE soh."orderdate" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh."orderdate" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY pc."name" ORDER BY total_qty DESC, pc."name" ASC
output_summary.explanation: 按 2024 年销售订单日期区间，汇总各产品大类（productcategory）下销售订单明细的订购数量 orderqty。通过 salesorderdetail 关联 salesorderheader 限定下单日期在 2024 年内，并沿 product→productsubcategory→productcategory 逐级内连接，因此仅统计有子类别归属的产品。结果按数量降序、大类名称升序排列。

input_summary.sql: SELECT pc."name" AS category_name, SUM(sod."orderqty") AS total_qty FROM "sales"."salesorderdetail" sod JOIN "sales"."salesorderheader" soh ON sod."salesorderid" = soh."salesorderid" JOIN "production"."product" p ON sod."productid" = p."productid" JOIN "production"."productsubcategory" ps ON p."productsubcategoryid" = ps."productsubcategoryid" JOIN "production"."productcategory" pc ON ps."productcategoryid" = pc."productcategoryid" WHERE soh."orderdate" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh."orderdate" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY pc."name" ORDER BY total_qty DESC, pc."name" ASC

output_summary.sql: SELECT pc."name" AS category_name, SUM(sod."orderqty") AS total_qty FROM "sales"."salesorderdetail" AS sod JOIN "sales"."salesorderheader" AS soh ON sod."salesorderid" = soh."salesorderid" JOIN "production"."product" AS p ON sod."productid" = p."productid" JOIN "production"."productsubcategory" AS ps ON p."productsubcategoryid" = ps."productsubcategoryid" JOIN "production"."productcategory" AS pc ON ps."productcategoryid" = pc."productcategoryid" WHERE soh."orderdate" >= CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND soh."orderdate" < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pc."name" ORDER BY total_qty DESC, pc."name" ASC LIMIT 200
